facts.fact: After a visit on 27 May 2021 UNDP and the commune of Lacs 1 (Aného) were said to have initiated projects to digitalise the registration of civil-status acts and of municipal taxes; no go-live or other commune is stated for the tax project.
The municipal tax digitalisation project in Lacs 1 is worked on with UNDP, which says it equipped about sixty communes with office furniture and IT equipment from 2020.
